Supply order for Ellmere depot.
Personnel: Greta out (Nils covering); Dell out (Rafe covering); Mira out (Greta covering); Una out (Teo covering); Leon out (Nils covering).
Desk swaps: Greta/Pia, Cora/Mira, Bram/Hugo, Suri/Nils, Pia/Hugo, Pia/Leon, Jonah/Bram, Una/Vik, Leon/Teo.
Issues: East wing too cold in afternoons. Lifts near East, North, loading bay, print room, library annex, garden studio, and harbour room are slow today. Harbour room repainting (afternoon noise). Umbrella left in loading bay, garden studio, and north office. Mira/Una think north office too cold in evening. Hugo thinks harbour room too cold in morning.
Order items: 515 crates; 400 ladders.
Office updates: North office kept clear for visitors. North office coffee machine working. Garden studio repainting (morning noise). Morning stand-up in North office. Loading bay repainting (morning noise). Library annex/Loading bay coffee machines working. Afternoon stand-up in library annex.
Environment: Teo/Ada prefer garden studio. Bram/Ines/Leon/Mira prefer east wing. Wren prefers north office. Kira/Opal prefer loading bay. Opal also prefers harbour room. Suri wants garden studio clear.
Pending tasks: Send meeting notes to Esme, Mira, Dell, Vik, Opal, Kira, Jonah. Draft note to Mira. Remind user Bram prefers library annex. Check with Kira. Keep loading bay, garden studio, north office, print room clear for visitors. Check availability for Cora, Vik, print room. Finn asked about north office evening availability.
